package repository

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type DiagnosticAssessmentRepository interface {
	ReplayDiagnosticReservation(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error)
	ReplayDiagnosticSubmission(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error)
	ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error)
	GetDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error)
	GetCurrentDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error)
	SubmitDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error)
	CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, bool, error)
}

type DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand struct {
	Plan                   domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
	RequestID, RequestHash string
	OccurredAt             time.Time
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand struct {
	StudentID, AttemptID, TaskID, RequestID, RequestHash string
	Response                                             json.RawMessage
	Correct                                              bool
	OccurredAt                                           time.Time
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand struct {
	StudentID, AttemptID, RequestID, RequestHash string
	OccurredAt                                   time.Time
}
